definitions.explanation: Flowers cut from the plant with their stems, used for arranging in a vase or as a bouquet, as opposed to potted or growing plants.

examples.japanese: {切|き}り{花|ばな}を{花瓶|かびん}に{生|い}けた。
examples.english: I arranged cut flowers in a vase.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}に{切|き}り{花|ばな}の{花束|はなたば}を{贈|おく}った。
examples.english: I gave my mother a bouquet of cut flowers.

examples.japanese: {切|き}り{花|ばな}を{長持|ながも}ちさせるには、{毎日|まいにち}{水|みず}を{替|か}えるとよい。
examples.english: To make cut flowers last longer, it is good to change the water every day.

notes:
Flowers cut with their stems for display in a vase or as a bouquet, as opposed to potted or growing plants.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {切|き}り{花|ばな}を{生|い}ける: to arrange cut flowers
- {切|き}り{花|ばな}が{長持|ながも}ちする: cut flowers last a long time
- {切|き}り{花|ばな}{用|よう}の{延命剤|えんめいざい}: cut-flower preservative

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鉢植|はちう}え: potted plant — grown in a pot with roots intact
